name: AXMOD
about: The AXMOD settings: one list for every platform (Electron, browsers, and later Swift). Option ids, types, defaults and presets mean the same thing everywhere. Settings are saved as { "schema": 1, "values": { <only the options the person changed> }, "channels": { <id>: 0..1 } }.

options.label: Text size
options.hint: Makes everything bigger, the receiver included.

options.label: High contrast
options.hint: Black, white and yellow. Sets the skin aside while it's on.

options.label: Colourblind-safe colours
options.hint: Okabe-Ito colours for status lights, the EQ and categories, with outlines.

options.label: Grayscale
options.hint: Takes the colour out of everything.

options.label: Colour strength
options.hint: Turn it down if colours feel loud.

options.label: Underline links and bold focus ring
options.hint: A thick yellow ring with a black halo shows where the keyboard is.

options.label: Big cursor
options.hint: A larger, high-contrast pointer.

options.label: Font
options.hint: Atkinson Hyperlegible is built for low vision; OpenDyslexic weights the bottom of each letter.

options.label: Wider spacing
options.hint: Line height 1.9, letters .12em, words .16em, paragraphs 2em.

options.label: Left-aligned text
options.hint: No centred or justified paragraphs.

options.label: Reading ruler
options.hint: A bright band follows your pointer or keyboard and dims the rest.

options.label: Read aloud as I move
options.hint: Says the name of each control you focus. Cmd+Option+S reads your selection.

options.label: Voice
options.hint: Voices installed on this computer.

options.label: Reduce motion
options.hint: Stops animations and slides. On by default when your computer asks for less motion.

options.label: No flashing
options.hint: Off by default: some skins flash on purpose, and Default never does. Turn it on to slow anything that would blink faster than three times a second.

options.label: No idle surprises
options.hint: Nothing moves on its own: the EQ holds still and the fruit flies stay away.

options.label: Buttons stay put
options.hint: No moving targets, and small buttons get bigger click areas.

options.label: Calm mode
options.hint: Hides skin decorations, stops all motion and mutes stingers and sound effects.

options.label: Sound captions
options.hint: Visible text for everything you'd hear: voices, songs and sound effects.

options.label: Lock the layout
options.hint: Clicks never change the look or open things you didn't ask for. Skin choice is locked too.

options.label: Text version of visuals
options.hint: Meters, charts and the EQ also show as plain text.

options.label: Keyboard shortcuts
options.hint: Cmd+Option+A opens this drawer, Cmd+Option+S reads aloud, Esc stops speech.

shortcuts: Read the selection (or what's focused) aloud
